data.name: Wheat Kernels
data.abstract: Measurements of morphological descriptors  of wheat kernels from Punjab State. A machine Learning based technique was used to extract 15 features, all are real valued attributes

additional_info.summary: The examined group comprised kernels of wheat : PBW-550U randomly selected for the experiment. High Quality Manual Visualisation of the external Kernel. It is non-destructive technique.The images were recorded using Basler Sca-17fc industrial graded color camera. The dataset can be used for tasks of classification.
